description: Additional YAML parsing edge cases for quoted scalar preservation, anchor/alias detection, alias enum resolution, and encoding metadata validation.

input.yaml:
openapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: Anchors
  version: "1.0"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    Shared:
      type: object
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          enum: &status.values-v2
            - alpha
            - beta
    Consumer:
      type: object
      properties:
        code: {type: string, enum: *status.values-v2}

openapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: Plain
  version: "1.0"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    Plain:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: uses ampersands and asterisks as prose only

openapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: Inline Enum
  version: "1.0"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    InlineConsumer:
      type: object
      properties:
        priority:
          type: string
          enum:
            - low
            - medium
            - high

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Multipart API
  version: "1.0"
paths:
  /upload:
    post:
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                document:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                metadata:
                  type: string
            encoding:
              document:
                contentType: application/pdf
              metadata:
                contentType: application/json
      responses:
        201:
          description: Created
